scenario: Greeting someone for the first time
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Se usa en presentaciones: 'Nice to meet you'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello! My name is Ana.
dialogue.translation: Murahe! Izina ryanje ni Ana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hi, Ana. Nice to meet you. I am Carlos.
dialogue.translation: Murahe, Ana. Nshatse kubura wowe. Nze ni Carlos.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too. This is my friend, Luis.
dialogue.translation: Nanjye nashatse kubura wowe. Uyu ni official yange, Luis.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Hello, Luis. I am from Spain.
dialogue.translation: Murahe, Luis. Nze ni mu Espanya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And I am from Mexico. Welcome!
dialogue.translation: Na nze ni mu Mekisi. Urahkwe!

scenario: Asking where something is in a store
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Umwanya w’umuntu wumwe w’igisubirano cy’ijambo ‘to be’.
Ijambo rifatanya kuri ikintu cyashyizwe guhakwa.
Mu ‘over there’ bishobora kubwira ‘hari’ cyangwa ‘mu kando’.
Mu ‘right there’ bishobora kubwira ‘hari no hari’.
Ikintu cyangwa uruganda rw’ibanga kugira ngo ubuke ibintu.
Mu buryo bwo kwiga, bishobora kubwira ‘gutanga’ cyangwa ‘gucura’.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where is the bread?
dialogue.translation: Niba wabaye, ni aho ubu bufuri buhaye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is over there, on that shelf.
dialogue.translation: Ari mu kando, kuri uruganda rw’ibanga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it right there?
dialogue.translation: Ese ari hari no hari?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes. You need to get it from the top.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Gusaba gutanga ku buryo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Murakoze!

scenario: Ordering a drink at a café
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ishimwe kugira icyo wipfuza mu kumenya neza: 'Can I have...?'
Mu gihe kiki bikaba bishimira 'gutara' ikinyobwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What can I get for you?
dialogue.translation: Ikihe nashobora kugufata?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Can I have a coffee, please?
dialogue.translation: Nashobora gutara ikawa, jye we?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hot or cold?
dialogue.translation: Cyoroheje cyangwa kibaya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hot, please. And what tea do you have?
dialogue.translation: Cyoroheje, jye we. N'ikihe gitenge mufite?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here you go. Your coffee and tea.
dialogue.translation: Hano wenda. Ikawa n'igitenge cyawe.

key_phrases.phrase: What can I get for you?

scenario: Buying a ticket at a station
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ishrwa kugirango utangire akabiri, nk'ako 'one ticket'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want one ticket to London, please.
dialogue.translation: Nashaka akabiri kuri London, jye we.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: For today, with the train now?
dialogue.translation: Kuri uyu munsi, na y'egitegeko buno?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but very early, and then I go to work.
dialogue.translation: Yee, arikubera ari bya kera, hanyuma natega ku murimo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: OK, you have the train at six. That is good.
dialogue.translation: OK, unegitegeko ku mbara. Ni byiza.

scenario: Checking in at a hotel reception
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
dialogue.translation: Mwiriwe. Mufite ububiko?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have a room for two nights.
dialogue.translation: Yego, dushyigikiwe isima kuri indwi z'ijoro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here is your key. Your room is on the third floor.
dialogue.translation: Naho urubibi rwanyu. Isima yanyu iri kumukanda wa gatatu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thank you. We need help with our bags.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze. Dusaba ubufasha ku bagasi zacu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. How long do you want to stay?
dialogue.translation: Nk'abagamba. Mushaka kwiga mute?

key_phrases.phrase: How long do you want to stay?

scenario: Meeting a new neighbor
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ibimenyetso ko ikintu cyagenze hagati y'ubushishaye.
Mu icyo gice, 'move' bishobora gusobanura guhindura aho uri.
Igice cy'ubushakashatsi cyibimenyetso ko ikintu kigenzuye.
Ikorwa kugirango ubusabe aho uri cyangwa igihe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! I see you just moved into the house next door.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse! Nabona ko waragiye mu rugo uri hafi y'ikinyampumuro.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I live here now. It is my new home.
dialogue.translation: Yego, nzagura hano ubu. Ni uyu mu rugo wanjye mpya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is great! So, do you need help with your things today?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza cyane! Bityo, esa wifuza ubufasha mu kintu wako ubu nsinda?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe later. Oh, the door is open. Let me close it.
dialogue.translation: Shyiramo kurushwa. Eya, ikinyampumuro bifunguye. Njakibije.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No problem. I am at home all morning. Come by any time.
dialogue.translation: Nta cyaha. Nzagura mu rugo buri yu buto. Uraho uwo munsi woshobora guza.

scenario: Asking the time on the street
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ishimwa kugira ububiko igihe: 'What time is it?'
Mu kontegisi iyi, 'Do you have the time?' = Ufite igihe?
Mu 'Can you tell me...' = Weshobora kuvuga...
Ishimwa kugira ububiko ubwenge: 'I don't know.'
Ishimwa kugira ububiko kure cyangwa igihe cyose.
Ishimwa kugira ububiko igihe: 'at three' = mu maso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you have the time?
dialogue.translation: Mbabarira, ufite igihe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sorry, I don't know. I don't have a watch.
dialogue.translation: Ndabibuka, nta menya. Nta reba nfite.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, but can you tell me if it's late?
dialogue.translation: Oh, ariko weshobora kuvuga niba ari kure?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think it's about three now.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza ari ku mpande z'amaso buno.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you! See you at three then.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze! Tubyivurane mu maso hanyuma.

scenario: At the doctor for a basic checkup
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashishwa kugena uburyo uriho kuri mubiri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How do you feel today?
dialogue.translation: Ubura gute?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not better than yesterday. I have some pain here.
dialogue.translation: Nta neza kurushaho ejo. Nifite ubumuga hano.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You should take this medicine. All is fine, but rest more.
dialogue.translation: Gushobora kugura ubu mubiri. Byose byiza, ariko umuneze bigeze.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: How much do I take each day?
dialogue.translation: Nshobora kugura iki cyakabaje kuri munsi?

scenario: Paying at a supermarket checkout
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is the total. The price is twenty dollars.
dialogue.translation: Ibi ni igice cyose. Igici ni ama dola 20.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: OK. How much does it cost? Can I pay with a card?
dialogue.translation: Nyayo. Nigura ama dola 20? Nashobora gura n'ikarata?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, here is the card machine. And here is your receipt.
dialogue.translation: Yego, hano hari mashini y'ikarata. Kandi hano hari risito yawe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thank you. I am out of cash, so card is good.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze. Nta mafaranga yo hagati nifite, bityo ikarata ni nyiraturuka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here is your change. Have a nice day!
dialogue.translation: Hano hari igici kinini. Umunsi wiza!

scenario: Calling a friend to make simple plans
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, this is me. Can you call me today?
dialogue.translation: Murahe, njye ni jya. Ushobora kundagira interuro none?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I can call you now. Where are you?
dialogue.translation: Yego, nashobora kundagira interuro buri. Uri hehe?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I am at home. Can you see me tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Njye niri mu ruhande. Ushobora kubona ejo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I can see you tomorrow. Where do we meet?
dialogue.translation: Yego, nashobora kubona ejo. Tuvanye hehe?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Meet me on this street, near the park.
dialogue.translation: Njye njye ku izina rya iyi, hafi y'umutwe.

key_phrases.translation: njye njye ku izina rya iyi

scenario: Describing your family to someone
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa kugirango jye umuryango w'inzu canke abagize.
Ikoreshwa kuri shushanyana, nta bimenyesha y'umukuru canke umunini.
Ikoreshwa kuri ndangano, nta bimenyesha y'umukuru canke umunini.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tell me about your family.
dialogue.translation: Vuga iby'umuryango wawe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I live with my mother, father, and two sisters. My brother is not at home.
dialogue.translation: Nabra na maman, daddy, na abashushanyana babiri. Ndangano yanjye atari mu rugo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is your father old or young?
dialogue.translation: Ese daddy wawe ari gakuru cyangwa gakuru?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: He is not very old, but my mother is very young.
dialogue.translation: Ntacyane gakuru, ariko maman yanjye ari gakuru cyane.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And your sisters? Are they young too?
dialogue.translation: N'abashushanyana bawe? None se barimo barimo bakuru?

key_phrases.phrase: live with my mother and father

scenario: Asking for directions in the street
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is the station far from here?
dialogue.translation: Niba wabaye, ese isita ari ikirefu mu kuri hano?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's near. Go straight and turn left at the next street.
dialogue.translation: Oya, ari hafi. Genda mu murongo kuguruka ibumoso mu muhanda wacyatumye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Go straight and turn left? Is that right?
dialogue.translation: Genda mu murongo kuguruka ibumoso? Ese ni ibumeneko?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's right. Then go straight again. The station is on your right.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ni ibumeneko. Hanyuma genda mu murongo nanone. Isita iri ibumeneko.

scenario: On a bus asking the driver for help
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Icyifuzo kuri kandi kugirango turondere kuri paratada yo busi.
Mu icyo gihangayawe, 'get off' bifuza kubura.
Kugirango ubaze uburira mu ntambwe zikurikira.
Ijambo ry'ubwubahirizo rihagije mu gutanga ubufasha.
Ibiranga ububiko bwo gushaka cyangwa ububiko.
Ibanga ahantu haruguru kuri uyu mwanya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, can you help me? I need to get off at the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Niba wabaye, ushobora kundefasha? Nshaka kubura mu paratada yikurikira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Which stop do you want? This is the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Ushaka paratada pi? Iyi ni paratada yikurikira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want the stop near the hospital. How many stops from here?
dialogue.translation: Nshaka paratada haruguru urugo rw'abagi. Ni paratada pafite gutandukana hano?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's three stops down. Please sit down, I will tell you.
dialogue.translation: Ni paratada itatu tukabura. Niba wabaye, kanda ubure, nzabibwira.

key_phrases.phrase: get off at the next stop

scenario: Introducing a colleague at work
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashishwa kugirango jye kurondera aho cyangwa igikorwa gishinzwe.
Bifashishwa kugirango jye kwanira umuntu waje kuri buri munsi.
Mu gihe kiki, 'meet' bifasha 'gutahura' mu gihe kigeze.
Bifashishwa kugirango jye kushyiraho ubushishozi cyangwa ubufaranga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, this is our new colleague. Her name is Ana.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, uwo ni gishigiki kishya cyacu. Izina rye ni Ana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Ana. What do you do here?
dialogue.translation: Nafashe neza gutahura na we, Ana. Ukozwa iki hano?

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: She works in our team. He is her manager.
dialogue.translation: Yaye akora mu gishigiki cyacu. Ye ni umukuru wiwe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good! I want to work with you.
dialogue.translation: Nziza! Ndasaba gusohoza na we.

scenario: Leaving a voicemail message
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, this is Ana. Please leave a message after the beep.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, njye ni Ana. Niba witeze, gushyigikira intamabara nyuma y'igicu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hi Ana, this is Luis. Please call me back soon.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse Ana, njye ni Luis. Niba witeze, nkurangirire guteza bumeze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, Luis. What is your number?
dialogue.translation: Nyayo, Luis. Nimero yawe ni eye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is 555-1234. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Ni 555-1234. Murakoze!

scenario: At the post office sending a package
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Mu kontegisti k'iyi muri, 'have' bikorwa nk'ijambo ry'inyungamugayo mu kuba ufite

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to send this package to my friend.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kuhereza ikinyabaganya k'iyi kuri umugenzi wanjye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have it at the counter. Please fill out this form for the package.
dialogue.translation: Dufite iyo mu kurebure. Ndagukire usome iki fommu ku byo kinyabaganya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is this all for the package?
dialogue.translation: Ese byose byo ni byo kinyabaganya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have all we need. You can send it now.
dialogue.translation: Yego, dufite byose twakeneye. Ukuze woherereze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze.

scenario: Describing your daily routine
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Verbo frasal gishyashya kuri 'kubura mu moso.'
Igice cy'umunsi gishikira kuri 6 kugeza ku 12.
Kuri tereve yo kubona cyangwa ikintu gikorwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I get up at seven in the morning.
dialogue.translation: Nkubura saa mo 7 ikinyamunywa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I have breakfast and go to work.
dialogue.translation: Hanyuma njya nzakira no kwimura gukorera.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I work at home in the evening.
dialogue.translation: Nkorera mu rugo ikiramya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I watch TV because I like it.
dialogue.translation: Nbona tereve kubera ko nifise.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then I sleep at ten.
dialogue.translation: Hanyuma nkwirinda saa 10.

scenario: Asking about opening hours
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ikoraniye kugena aho kuri abantu bose.
Ikoresha kuduha itangi ry'igishushanyo, hano igishushanyo ni mu kanya.
Mu kino kiganiro kiranga igihe cy'isaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you tell me the open time today?
dialogue.translation: Wishobora kundushyiraho igihe cyo gutangira none?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We open at nine, but we close at five.
dialogue.translation: Duca mu kanya saa 9, ahubwo ducura saa 5.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And on Saturday, until what time are you open?
dialogue.translation: Nuko ku munsi w'isabiti, muca mubungiriye kugeza aho igihe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: On Saturday, we close at one.
dialogue.translation: Ku munsi w'isabiti, ducura saa 1.

scenario: Choosing a dish from a menu
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you like to eat?
dialogue.translation: Wagushimisha kurya iki?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like fish or chicken with rice.
dialogue.translation: Ndagushimisha isambaza cyangwa inkoko na maguru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The fish is very good here.
dialogue.translation: Isambaza ari nziza cyane hano.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I try some fish, please.
dialogue.translation: Nubwo ngarukane isambaza birahindwa, njuganye.

key_phrases.phrase: What do you like to eat?
The fish is very good here.

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Bishoboka kuba determiner ('more money') cyangwa adverb ('more quickly').

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: Ndagukunda ikibanza buno.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: Hano ari karta yawe. Genda hari na karti yawe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: Wabereye kuguma amafaranga menshi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Yego, nzaguha ikibanza buno. Genda hari.
